scope: league-wide NBA skill/context acquisition after feasibility; not a four-player study

season_policy.postseason: optional separately typed matched prior-season samples, never pooled silently
season_policy.demo_warning: 2019-20 is not last season; year selectors may use ending year

groups.purpose: Accuracy, difficulty and self-creation rather than one shooting rank
groups.engine_use_note: shooting_range / shot_versatility; no direct release-time measurement

groups.purpose: Catch-and-shoot, pull-up, deep and midrange profiles
Getting to the rim versus converting chances
groups.engine_use_note: rim_pressure combines distinct access and finishing; do not double count composite
contact-finish denominator is fouled 2pt attempts, not all contact; post skill and opportunity differ

groups.purpose: Passing production, reads, quality and ball security relative to opportunity
groups.engine_use_note: passing_reads / handle_pressure; no direct pressure-specific handle or processing-speed measurement confirmed
screen model versus role/volume-adjusted scoring; impact name here means action production, not standalone intrinsic skill

groups.purpose: Cutting, off-screen use and movement context
groups.engine_use_note: movement speed/distance relative to offensive role, not intrinsic speed or stamina
offensive_rebounding; crash execution is not necessarily coach-selected crash tendency

groups.purpose: Separate securing rebounds and chance creation
groups.engine_use_note: DREB evidence may support blueprint; no automatic new trait or rim proxy substitution
rim_deterrence; composite includes subchannels; height/role bonuses not additional observed evidence

groups.purpose: Containment and navigation distinct from activity
groups.engine_use_note: lateral / navigation evidence; provider estimates not pure physical tests

groups.purpose: Help execution, disruptions and work context
groups.engine_use_note: scheme_iq / defensive_effort; distance and role-adjusted travel not cardio capacity

groups.purpose: What was assigned, not what ability must be
groups.engine_use_note: experimental role context only; no label-based talent grants

roles and difficulty exist but row-level shares/IDs availability unverified

requested_not_confirmed.reason: no public skills-export promise verified; must use exposed permitted download/copy methods

supporting_P2.scope: same useful P1 families in2023-24 where available, season-age/injury/role flags and historical definitions; complete all requested-year presence/missingness matrix
supporting_P2.do_not_infer: absence does not mean zero ability; prior season not NBA yet, injury or metric not collected may explain absence

families: Offensive Talent / Defensive Talent composites and optimization
stabilized lineup outcomes and teammate/opponent context
optional_P3.purpose: validation, drift/confounder checks and forecasts only; no direct simulator coefficients or imported potential/growth mechanics
optional_P3.access_status: package/free-tool documentation varies; exact fields/seasons/player rows unverified except prior historical sample

population.acquire: all exposed NBA player-season rows in essential seasons, including low-minute/free-agent and traded players; do not restrict to stars or prototype cases
population.join: provider IDs to canonical IDs via explicit NBA/ESPN/name-team-season crosswalk; no invented ID
report_strata: current free agents with NBA history
population.no_ability_filter: minutes threshold for reports is not acquisition eligibility or talent floor

permitted_paths: exposed provider CSV/XLSX or documented download if actually available
exposed table copy with headers and pagination manifest when permitted
visible read-only table capture with exact filters and QA when permitted; no hidden state/endpoints
not_authorized: bulk player data acquisition in this planning task

success_targets.identity_coverage: goal >=95% eligible canonical NBA veterans for each completed essential season, with100% unmatched/missing rows assigned reasons; target not promise
success_targets.channel_coverage: all13 P1 groups attempted league-wide; report each exact metric and channel coverage, opportunity/sample quality separately, and never call a composite-only group independent subchannel coverage
success_targets.missingness: no silent zero-fill; unknown denominators/units explicitly recorded
success_targets.reproducibility: each preserved batch has source/filter/as-of/retrieval/representation/hash metadata; normalized records link back to raw cells
success_targets.value: two observed seasons of broad distinct offense/defense/context coverage outweigh many redundant columns or a narrow star-only sample
